headline: Rome, rental of e-scooters and bikes: over 2.5 million euros in fines from the Antitrust Authority on 3 companies
summary: Italy's Antitrust Authority imposed fines of over 2.6 million euros on three e-scooter rental companies operating in Rome. The fines were decided against the three firms.
why: The Italian Antitrust Authority enforces competition law, and its fines can affect operators' profitability and business practices in urban mobility markets.
